subject: Oceanography
title: Citizen Science
description: A micro-lesson that makes Citizen Science usable.

hook.text: Thousands of divers, surfers, and beachgoers collect ocean data that scientists could never gather alone.

buildup.text: Programs like Reef Check train volunteers to survey coral health—creating global datasets since 1997.

discovery.text: Whale photo-ID projects use tourist photos to track individual animals—matching tail fluke patterns across years.

twist.text: Apps like iNaturalist let anyone photograph marine species—AI helps identify them, building biodiversity maps.

climax.text: Citizen science has discovered new species, tracked pollution, and provided evidence for marine protected areas.

punchline.text: Everyone near the ocean can be a scientist—data is everywhere.

quiz.question: How does citizen science help ocean conservation?
options: Volunteers collect data scientists couldn't gather alone
